title: My reoccurring dream about a “artificial world”…
content: I’m not sure if this will resonate with anyone as it’s hard to put into words and explain but I’m gonna try because I’m fascinated by it and wanna know if anyone has dreamt anything similar. It definitely connects to mall world somehow. So I’ve been having these reoccurring dreams where I am in a “artificial like” world that is the same as ours but once u get a closer look it’s off or “fake”. For example.. the grocery/department store.. this one is frequently in my dreams. It’s not a normal store even though everything looks real, like there’s name brand food and what not. But once u get closer u can see it’s off brand/ not exactly real if that makes sense. It looks extremely real at first, then u realize it’s not. I think if i remember correctly everything is always super super cheap too. So I get excited to “go shopping” in my dream before I realize it’s not even the real thing and it’s artificially made or something. Another example is I had this one dream where I was just kinda “there” at this place and it almost felt like a video game (it was not a video game that’s just how it felt, very artificial. Was not a store this time but just a simple “world” like I was walking past people in this neighborhood and i remember I tried to drink a cup of water or something and I couldn’t. I physically couldn’t. And the “people” I was with (strangers) said oh yeah you can’t do anything physical here. Like I could walk (I think) but I couldn’t eat, drink, sleep ect because everything including the people were fake. Like we were dolls inside a doll world or something and I was the only human. The thing is they didn’t look like dolls though and everything looked real. But u somehow “knew” it wasn’t. Last example is i remember seeing this “forbidden” area in this world. It’s always dark when I see it but it’s basically like a gated community. If I wanted to get into it I’d have to climb over the white fence but when I tried in my dream I seen cops. It’s like a closed in, neighborhood in this fake doll world. I never get in there though. I think I got close to getting in one time but I either woke up or didn’t make it all the way through cause all i remember is it’s always nighttime, big closed in gated community neighborhood thing, fake or “artificial” but looks real world, and the fence around it is white and it’s a very big neighborhood/community that seems like it goes on for a time. Has any experienced anything like these?
